WD Cable creates a private local link between nearby devices using Wi-Fi Direct. Once connected, the devices share one app session for chat, file transfer, speed testing, and audio.
 No internet, router, hotspot, account, or cloud service is required. The connection stays local between the participating devices.
 Features:
 Direct device-to-device connection over Wi-Fi Direct.
 High-speed local file transfer.
 Real-time chat between connected peers.
 Protocol v2 transport setup with UDP rendezvous and detailed diagnostics.
 Low-latency Audio Link using RTP/RTCP over UDP with libopus.
 Selectable sender audio quality and latency modes.
 Built-in upload and download speed tests.
 The Android app can connect to another Android device running WD Cable. A separate Windows companion client is also available for Android-to-Windows workflows, including using an Android device as a local microphone sender.
 Version 2.0.1 uses Protocol v2 and is not compatible with Protocol v1 builds. Both devices must run WD Cable 2.0.1 or another Protocol v2-compatible build.
 Requires Android 13 or newer. Release APKs support arm64-v8a and x86_64 devices; 32-bit armeabi-v7a devices are not supported.
 WD Cable is designed for offline peer-to-peer experiments, local transfer, quick device-to-device testing, and private nearby sharing.

fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.name: GrooveForge
fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.summary: MIDI synth with soundfonts, 92 microtonal scales, and offline band rehearsals
fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.description:
GrooveForge is a portable MIDI keyboard studio for Android. Plug in a MIDI controller, pick a soundfont, and play.
It began as a practice companion, light enough to carry on a phone or tablet, for rebuilding scales and muscle memory at a keyboard. It grew well beyond that, but it remains a tool for practising and playing, not a DAW.
Rehearsals
A band learning a tune together, without a studio. Everyone records their own part over a shared click, on their own phone, and the parts collect into one arrangement that every device holds a full copy of.
Import a recording to play along to — MP3, FLAC and WAV everywhere, plus M4A, AAC and the sound of a video on Android. Tap the tempo, then drag a marker to the first downbeat so the grid lines up with the music.
Every device delays sound on the way out and on the way in, which would push each take late. GrooveForge measures that delay on your device and shifts your take back by it, so what you played on the beat lands on the beat.
Nothing is uploaded anywhere and no account is needed. Devices sync directly over the local network: scan a code once, then opening the same tune is enough. No internet needed, and without Wi-Fi one phone's hotspot is the whole network.
Instruments
GrooveForge Keyboard — soundfont synth (.sf2) with bank and patch selection and MIDI channel routing. Every slot is independent.
Vocoder — mic-driven voice synthesis.
Stylophone — monophonic metal-strip instrument.
Theremin — touch pad with vertical pitch and horizontal volume.
Drum Generator — beat patterns from bossa nova to metal, with human feel.
Xen: microtonal scales
Hold a note, tap a scale. The note you are holding becomes the tonic, the keyboard locks to the scale built on it, and — for scales that are not equal-tempered — the keys it uses are retuned to sound as the tradition intends. One keyboard, one gesture.
92 scales across eleven families: Western modes; Arabic and Turkish maqamat; Persian dastgah; Indian ragas in just intonation; Chinese, Japanese and Korean modes; Thai seven-equal; Javanese and Balinese gamelan; Ethiopian qenet and Ugandan amadinda; Highland pipe, hardanger fiddle and Byzantine chant; historical temperaments; and equal divisions from 13 to 31 tones, Bohlen-Pierce, and Wendy Carlos's non-octave alpha, beta and gamma.
Retuning uses a full MIDI tuning table rather than pitch bend, so every note of a chord sounds at its own correct pitch. Out-of-scale keys grey out and retuned ones show their offset in cents.
Each scale says where its numbers come from: a temperament is exact, a maqam follows the convention that notates it, a gamelan is tuned by ear and varies between instruments.
Build your own scales too — any number of degrees, an offset per key, and a mute that keeps a degree playable while the scale lock ignores it. Import and export Scala (.scl) files.
Loopers
MIDI Looper — record and loop MIDI patterns with bar sync.
Audio Looper — record and loop live audio with bar sync, overdub and reverse.
Effects
Plate reverb, ping-pong delay, wah (auto or pedal-controlled), 4-band EQ, compressor and chorus/flanger, with BPM sync where it makes sense. Live Input routes a microphone or line-in through any of them.
And the rest
Plugin rack — an ordered, drag-and-drop rack of module slots, reorderable at any time.
Scale lock and highlighting — root, in-scale and out-of-scale keys coloured on the on-screen keyboard.
Jam Mode — one slot leads; the slots after it lock to its harmony.
CC mapping — map hardware knobs, sliders and pads to MIDI effects or application actions.
Projects — save and restore complete rack configurations to a .gf file. The last session is autosaved on every change.
GrooveForge is free software, built by one developer in their spare time. Rough edges are expected, and releases happen when time allows.

fdroid:com.musheer360.swiftslate.description:
SwiftSlate is a system-wide AI text assistant for Android. Type a trigger like "?fix" at the end of any text, in any app, and watch it get replaced instantly.
It works in most apps — WhatsApp, Gmail, Twitter/X, Messages, Notes, and more. No copy-pasting. No app switching. Just type and go.
Features:
• Works system-wide via Android's Accessibility Service
• Also works from the text-selection menu in any app — no accessibility permission required
• Instant inline text replacement — AI response replaces your text directly
• Multi-provider AI: Google Gemini, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including local LLMs like Ollama and LM Studio)
• Text replacer commands run entirely offline with zero latency
• Multi-key rotation with automatic rate-limit handling
• API keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore
• AMOLED dark theme and light theme with Material 3
• Localized in 40 languages — the app follows your device language automatically
• Zero analytics, zero tracking, zero telemetry
• Tiny APK (~1.7 MB) with zero third-party networking dependencies
Built-in commands:
• ?fix — Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation
• ?improve — Improve clarity and readability
• ?shorten — Shorten while keeping meaning
• ?expand — Expand with more detail
• ?formal — Rewrite in professional tone
• ?casual — Rewrite in friendly tone
• ?emoji — Add relevant emojis
• ?human — Rewrite so it doesn't read as AI-generated
• ?reply — Generate a contextual reply
• ?undo — Restore text from before the last replacement
• ?translate:XX — Translate to any language
• ?copy / ?cut / ?paste / ?replace — Clipboard actions without leaving the keyboard
You can also create your own custom AI commands with any prompt, or text replacer commands for instant offline snippets like signatures, canned responses, and shortcuts.
An API key from Google Gemini (free tier available), Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible provider is needed for AI commands. Text replacer commands work without any API key.

fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.name: GPSd Forwarder
fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.summary: Service to forward NMEA messages to a GPSd server
fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.description:
This application forwards NMEA data from your phone's GPS to a specified host.
It's goal is to easily plug and feed data into a GPS server service (e.g. GPSd),
using your cellphone as a GPS device. This way, your cellphone can be used as a
GPS in navigation or robotics applications running in a host computer.
Data is forwarded using UDP. First, make sure the computer's IP is reachable
from your cellphone; this is the case in most default access points, so it
should work if both are connected to the same WiFi network.
On the host machine, execute `gpsd -N udp://:` (e.g. `gpsd -N udp://*:29998`). In
the app, enter your host's IP and port and hit Start. Your host is now
receiving GPS data forwarded from your phone. You can test it with gpsmon or
other GPSd utilities.

fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.name: PDF Docket
fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.summary: Keep PDF tickets and passes at hand and show their barcodes in fullscreen
fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.description:
PDF Docket stores and displays your most important PDFs, such as tickets, passes and certificates. It includes a convenient fullscreen barcode rendering, if a barcode is present in the PDF.
Brief Instruction
- Open "PDF Docket"
- Import PDF
- Done
Alternative Brief Instruction
- Go to your file browser, email, web browser or PDF reader app
- Open/Share the PDF with "PDF Docket"
- Done
Description
A very simple app that does nothing more than conveniently store and display PDF certificates. You can use it for public transport tickets, bills, contracts, certificates and any other PDF file.
The PDF file has to be imported into the app. Following that, the barcode is displayed in fullscreen, as well as the PDF document itself. That's already it.
Currently supported barcode formats are:
- Matrix (2D) codes: QR, Aztec, DataMatrix and PDF417
- Linear (1D) codes: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, EAN-13, CODE-39, CODE-93, CODE-128, ITF and Codabar
More Features
- Can detect and extract barcodes in PDFs
- Split screen shows the barcode and the PDF at the same time, and the PDF turns to the page of each barcode
- The split screen divider can be dragged, and barcodes can be turned by 90° with a double tap
- PDF pages can be shown whole or fitted to the width
- Turn the screen or pin the app before handing your phone over
- Documents reopen at the barcode and page they were left on
- (Optional) biometric authentication
- PDFs can be sorted by name, file size, import date, or dragged into your own order
- PDFs can be individually named
- Assign tags to documents and filter documents by tags
- Tags can have icons
- Documents can be shown as a grid or a list
- Documents can be archived instead of deleted, right away or automatically on a chosen date
- PDFs can be shared from other apps, also several at once
- Documents can be added to the home screen
- Encrypted backups of all documents and tags
- PDFs can be shared with other apps (indirectly allows printing)
- Dark Mode support (document stays in original color, optionally inverted)
- Also supports password protected PDFs
Privacy
This app values your privacy by working fully offline. No ads, no tracking.

fdroid:sh.fieldsmith.app.summary: Parametric CAD, 3D FEA & RF VNA solver with Haven MCP & remote compute
fdroid:sh.fieldsmith.app.description:
Fieldsmith is a parametric implicit CAD modeller, 3D quadratic (P2) finite-element solver, RF antenna VNA workbench, and TPMS lattice slicer built in Rust.
Mobile CAD Driven by Haven MCP & External Compute:

apple-macos:6447090616.description:
Whisper Notes turns voice memos, lectures, interviews and meetings into accurate text with speaker labels, 100% offline on your iPhone and iPad. One-time purchase, no subscription. Trusted by 70,000+ journalists, researchers and professionals.
■ Record and import
- Record from the Lock Screen, widgets, Control Center, the Action button, Apple Watch, or "Hey Siri".
- Import from Files, Photos or Voice Memos, several at once, or share from WhatsApp and any other app.
■ Transcribe
- Live transcription: your words appear on screen as you speak, in English and 24 other European languages.
- Speaker labels (speaker diarization) show who said what. Rename each speaker.
- Choose your on-device model: Parakeet, Whisper (OpenAI), SenseVoice, or Apple Speech on iOS 26.
- 99 languages through Whisper, detected automatically, even when speakers mix languages.
- Fast and unlimited: an hour of audio in under a minute with Parakeet, and no cap on how much you record or import.
■ Voice keyboard
- Dictate into any app: switch to the Whisper Notes keyboard, tap and speak, and your words are typed in.
- Works offline, in English and 24 other European languages. Nothing you dictate is saved.
■ Edit and export
- Double-tap any paragraph to fix a word.
- Export TXT, Markdown or SRT subtitles with timestamps and speaker labels. Works for videos too.
- Auto-save every new transcript to Files or iCloud Drive.
■ Private by design
Your recordings and transcripts never leave your device. Turn on airplane mode and Whisper Notes works exactly the same, which matters when the recording is an interview, a client meeting, or anything you wouldn't put on someone else's server.
■ One-time purchase
No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and the Mac App Store version. Not satisfied? Settings → Request Refund.
■ Quick answers
Does Whisper Notes work completely offline?
Yes. It transcribes on your iPhone or iPad, so it works in airplane mode. The built-in Parakeet model covers 25 European languages offline from the first launch; for other languages, download Whisper or SenseVoice once in the app.
Does Whisper Notes support live transcription?
Yes. With the built-in Parakeet model, text appears in real time as you record, in English and 24 other European languages. When you stop, the whole recording is transcribed again for the final note. Other languages are transcribed after you stop.
Is there a voice typing keyboard?
Yes. Add the Whisper Notes keyboard, then tap and speak in any app. It works offline in the same 25 languages.
Can it transcribe WhatsApp voice messages?
Yes. Share a voice message to Whisper Notes and it is transcribed offline.
Does it identify speakers?
Yes. Tap ⋯ on a note → Detect Speakers, and each passage is labeled by speaker, for up to 8 speakers.
Which model is best for Chinese, Japanese or Korean?
SenseVoice, built for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Cantonese.
Is there a time limit?
Each recording can be up to 24 hours long.
Which iPhones are supported?
Whisper Notes needs iPhone 12 or newer.
Your notes live only on your device, so deleting the app deletes them. Export what matters.
Questions? support@whispernotes.app · whispernotes.app

flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_g.name: DAMASK grid
flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_g.description:
DAMASK® is a unified multi-physics crystal plasticity simulation package. The solution of continuum mechanical boundary value problems requires a constitutive response that connects deformation and stress at each material point. This problem is solved in DAMASK on the basis of crystal plasticity using a variety of constitutive models and homogenization approaches. However, treating mechanics in isolation is no longer sufficient to study emergent advanced high-strength materials. In these materials, deformation happens interrelated with displacive phase transformation, significant heating, and potential damage evolution. Therefore, DAMASK is capable of handling multi-physics problems. Following a modular approach, additional field equations are solved in a fully coupled way using a staggered approach.
 The grid solver (damask_grid) operates on structured grids.

firefox-addons:3027040.name: Odoo Developer Toolkit
firefox-addons:3027040.summary: In-page DevTools for Odoo : inspect fields, OWL components, menus & visibility modifiers, trace RPC bursts & N+1 queries, generate XML/Python inheritance stubs, and diff environments—100% locally in your browser.
firefox-addons:3027040.description:
Odoo Developer Toolkit turns any Odoo backend tab into a fast, zero-setup developer workbench—running 100% locally against your existing browser session with zero external servers or telemetry.
Open the OwnDock in-page panel anytime with Ctrl+Alt+D, click the ⚡ launcher bubble, or press Ctrl+K for the Command Palette.
- Smart Inspector & Visibility Debugger
 Sonic Multi-Surface Hover & Alt+Click Lock: Hover any field, button, notebook page, menu item, or OWL component to see live metadata, then Alt+Click (or click the Sonic badge) to lock it into the inspector with a visual connector line.
Visibility Debugger (v16): Instant verdict answering "Why is this field hidden, read-only, or required?" across 4 layers: live DOM state, evaluated XML modifiers (invisible/readonly/required AST evaluator), Python fields_get attributes, and security groups.
View Health Check: Scans all views of the active model to detect stale field references (upgrade breakers), required fields missing from views, and fields marked invisible everywhere.
Element Provenance & Field Matrix: See which module originally defined a node and every module overriding it via XPath/attributes, plus a cross-view presence matrix (form, list, kanban, search) with one-click XML ID copy.
Translation Lens & Related-Model Deep Dive: Compare field labels/help across all installed languages side-by-side, and inspect related models (many2one/one2many/many2many) with live record counts and sample values.
 OWL Component Inspector
Inspect live OWL components ( owl fibers) directly on the page—view component names, props, useState state, env.services, template names (t-name), and file path hints.
Generate ready-to-use patch(Component.prototype) JS stubs and t-inherit XML templates in one click.
 Call Tracer, N+1 Detector & RPC Console
Interaction Burst Tracer: Groups call_kw traffic by the exact button click that triggered it, highlighting slowest calls and automatically flagging N+1 RPC patterns.
Error History & Click-Through: Captures failed JSON-RPC calls across SPA navigations and lets you jump straight to affected records or copy env['model'].browse([...]) snippets.
RPC Console 2.0: Execute call_kw requests with args/kwargs, browse collapsible JSON trees, save reusable snippets, and replay call history.
Optional Companion Module (odoo_dev_toolkit_server): Connect to local dev instances to unlock backend cProfile Python call trees and SQL EXPLAIN plans per RPC.
 Generators, Graph & Environment Tools
Code & Menu Generators: Generate Python model inheritance stubs, ir.ui.view XPath extensions, a drag-and-drop Visual View Builder, and Menu Lab (add-child, add-sibling, move, hide, delete XML for any menu or breadcrumb).
Interactive Dependency Graph: Click-through model & relation explorer with live record counts, field footprints, search, and breadcrumbs.
Time Travel & Snapshot Diff: Automatically records before/after field values on every web_save, exports model schemas/ACLs/record rules to JSON, and generates auto-fix stubs when comparing environments.
Zero-Reload SPA Model Detection: Tracks Odoo navigation (/odoo/...) instantaneously without requiring page refreshes.
 Privacy First
No external servers, no analytics, and no tracking. Every RPC call runs strictly between your browser tab and your logged-in Odoo instance.

firefox-addons:3007579.name: Wallsflow New Tab: Live Wallpapers & Widgets
firefox-addons:3007579.summary: Transform your New Tab into a calm, personalized space with live wallpapers, widgets, and ambient focus music.
firefox-addons:3007579.description:
You open a new tab dozens of times a day. Why should it be a blank page every time?
With Wallsflow New Tab, every tab opens on a live wallpaper you picked, with the time, the weather and your favourite shortcuts right there. When it is time to work, start a Pomodoro timer, put on some rain or the hum of a coffee shop, and get going. Free, no account, no ads.
Live wallpapers, not boring pictures
Put any video or photo you like on your new tab. Just drag the file onto the page. Got a few? They can change on their own every 5, 15 or 30 minutes, every hour, or with the time of day, with separate wallpapers for day and night. Pin your favourite to keep it on screen. Looking for ideas? The Download More Wallpapers button takes you to the free library on wallsflow.com . Want to save battery? Turn the animation off with one click.
Sounds and music for focus
23 ambient sounds you can mix however you like, from rain and a crackling campfire to the hum of a busy coffee shop. Each one has its own volume, and quick mixes are ready for the days you just need to get through. Prefer your own music? Paste a Spotify, YouTube or SoundCloud link and listen right from the tab. The music keeps playing when you open another tab.
A Pomodoro timer with your task list
Start the timer and your task list opens next to it, with the task you are working on written large, right under the timer. The rest of the screen fades back so nothing pulls you away. When the session ends, Wallsflow asks whether you finished the task and keeps count of today's sessions. You choose the lengths.
Everything you need, nothing you don't
• A 12 or 24 hour clock with the date and a greeting that follows the time of day and the weather
• Weather for your city or any other, in Celsius or Fahrenheit
• Search with your default search engine
• Shortcuts to the sites you use most, arranged the way you want
• Your Firefox bookmarks, with quick search
Turn off any widget you don't need with one click.
Just the way you like it
Blur or dim the wallpaper so text stays easy to read, change the text colour, choose where links open. Save your settings, shortcuts, playlists and tasks to a file and take them to another computer whenever you want.
In your language
The extension starts in your browser's language: English, Romanian, German, French or Spanish. You can change it anytime in Settings.
Your data stays with you
No account, no data collection. Your wallpapers, settings and tasks live in your browser. The extension only goes online for the weather, for city search, for your shortcut icons and for the music you play.
Install Wallsflow New Tab and open a new tab. You will see the difference in the first second.

firefox-addons:802681.description:
Website Theme Manager customizes a website(s) appearance; you can choose your desired style from " userstyles.org " website or write your own.
Note #1: "Website Theme Manager" addon is NOT affiliated with " userstyles.org " website at all. But, users can choose desired styles available in " userstyles.org " and use them with this addon.
Some features:
1. Enables you to easily manage (add, edit or remove) styles.
2. Enhances your browsing experience by allowing you to customize the way a website look.
3. By using custom styles (css) you can change colors, fonts, and almost all HTML contents within a page; meaning completely redesigning the entire page.
4. In order to add styles, there are two options available:
a. writing your custom style (css) or
b. adding it from userstyles.org site. Once you install the addon, please visit userstyles.org and find your desired theme, then click on "Add this Theme" (appears only after you install Website Theme Manager). The theme will be automatically added to the extension's options page, where you can easily edit, remove or inactivate it.
5. Toolbar icon can easily enable or disable the extension.
6. An example of how to add a style is available in the options page (top section).
Note #2: in order to report Bugs, please visit add-on's Homepage and fill the bug report form.

apple-itunes:6612027240.name: Nora Security Camera
apple-itunes:6612027240.description:
Use your phone as security camera to record and monitor your home, children or pets. Simply open this app, and turn your phone into a reliable security camera.
FEATURES
▪ Automatic motion and sound recording
▪ Real-time control and monitoring
▪ Encrypted data and connection
▪ Sync and access your videos on all devices
▪ Automatic notifications and alerts
▪ Battery efficiency of up to 24 hours
▪ Switch between front and rear camera
▪ Night vision
▪ Flashlight
▪ Adjustable detection zones and schedules
▪ Adjustable detection schedule
▪ Zoom on camera
▪ Remote control of your other phones
▪ Two-way audio communication
▪ Enhanced AI detection (early access)
AUTOMATIC RECORDING
Automatically record motion using your phone's front or rear camera. Videos are saved locally and synced to encrypted cloud storage, accessible remotely from your other devices. No pairing required — ideal for single devices or those without an internet connection.
REAL-TIME MONITORING
Watch, control, and receive critical alerts from your other phones in real-time. Live stream from the front or rear camera to maintain constant home security.
ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Instantly receive alerts, notifications, or video clips whenever motion or sound is detected. Get notified of critical events like low battery or connection issues.
SECURITY, PRIVACY AND ENCRYPTION
Your connection and data is secured with industry-standard end-to-end encryption. Only you can access and control your data.
STABILITY AND RELIABILITY
Nora™ app turns your phone into a security camera without the limitations of dedicated hardware. Capable of offline recording or using phone's cellular network connectivity, Nora™ operates independently of electricity outages, Wi-Fi connectivity, or network dependency. Our robust network architecture ensures high stability and performance.
MULTIPLE DEVICES
Connect up to 10 phones for real-time viewing and control. Nora™ supports phones, tablets and desktop browsers.
ADJUSTABLE HOURS AND ZONES
Schedule recording times and customize detection zones to focus on critical areas of your home.
ENHANCED AI RECOGNITION (BETA)
Gain early access to advanced AI features aimed at drastically improving motion recognition, performance efficiency, shape detection, and alert systems.
Visit oreon.com for more information.

apple-macos:917634022.name: IPinfo
apple-macos:917634022.description:
Know Your Network. Instantly.
See real-time IP and connection details across Wi-Fi, VPN, cellular, and Ethernet.
IPinfo gives you detailed information about your current network connections, including geolocation, ASN, IP addresses (IPv4 & IPv6), and provider data, all from your iPhone.
Features: 
Real-Time Network Monitoring
Track active connections across all interfaces — Wi-Fi, VPN, cellular, and Ethernet — with automatic updates as you switch networks.
Accurate IP Geolocation
View precise IP data including country, city, ASN, hostname, and provider info. See your location on an interactive map.
Connection History
Get automatic logs of all IPs you’ve connected to. Filter by network type and review details anytime.
On-Demand IP Lookup
Search any IP address to view associated location, network, and ownership data.
Widgets for Quick Access
Add IPinfo widgets to your Home or Lock Screen to monitor your current IP and network status at a glance.

apple-macos:6761675261.name: LitPads — Custom Soundboard
apple-macos:6761675261.description:
Make your own soundboard in seconds. Add your own sounds or record them, tap a pad and it plays instantly. Then turn any sound into a monster, a robot or a chipmunk with one tap.
LitPads is the custom soundboard for streamers, podcasters, theater and church sound, DJs, tabletop game masters, teachers and anyone who needs the right sound at the right moment. One app for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
BUILD YOUR BOARD
• Import audio from Files, iCloud Drive, Dropbox or Google Drive, or record right in the app
• Trim sounds on a zoomable waveform and set a fade in and fade out for every pad
• Name and color your pads, pick from seven skins like Neon Circuit, Vinyl and Cassette
• Sort boards into folders and find any pad with search
VOICE FX AND 240+ SOUNDS
• Nine voice characters: Chipmunk, Helium, Monster, Giant, Robot, Glitch, Telephone, Radio and Alien
• A built-in library of 240+ meme and reaction sounds in 23 categories, from air horns and Vine boom to sad trombone and drum rolls
• Put animated videos and GIFs on your pads
STUDIO SOUND ON EVERY PAD
• 3-band EQ, pitch shift of up to 24 semitones and speed from 0.5x to 2x without changing the pitch
• Reverb with six rooms from small room to cathedral, plus a delay for echoes
PLAY IT LIVE
• One Shot, Toggle and Hold pads that play through, loop or resume where they stopped
• Solo pads, one-at-a-time boards and ducking that lowers other pads automatically
• Pads that start the next pad when they end, and cue lists with a big GO button for shows
• Fade out everything with one tap, run countdown timers from your pads
• The lock screen shows what is playing
MIDI AND REMOTE CONTROL
• Play pads from any MIDI controller with MIDI Learn or map a whole board at once, velocity sensitive
• Send MIDI from your pads to lighting desks and other gear
• Use your iPhone or iPad as a remote for LitPads on your Mac
SYNC AND SHARE
• iCloud sync keeps your boards the same on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Share whole boards as .soundboard files
ON YOUR MAC
LitPads on Mac adds OBS control, a Stream Window with stinger videos and overlays, global hotkeys and Stream Deck support. Route your sounds into OBS, Discord or Zoom with LitLink, our companion audio driver.
FREE TO START, PRO ONCE
Free: 6 boards with 20 pads each, every play mode, recording, trimming, fades, solo and all seven skins. You can try every voice and effect before you buy.
Pro is one purchase: unlimited boards with up to 32 pads each, Voice FX, the Sound Library, EQ, pitch and speed, reverb and delay, MIDI, cue lists, ducking, iCloud sync and every streaming tool. Buy once on any device and Pro unlocks on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account. No subscription. No ads.

apple-itunes:746894884.name: Google TV: Watch Movies & TV
apple-itunes:746894884.description:
The Google TV app, previously Play Movies & TV, makes it easy to find and enjoy the entertainment you love from across your apps, all in one place. With Google TV, you'll be able to:
Find what to watch next
Browse movies and TV episodes from across your streaming apps, all in one place and organized into topics and genres. Discover new things with recommendations based on what you love and what’s trending across the services you already have access to. Search for titles to see which apps are streaming them.
Create a list for all your discoveries
Add interesting shows and movies to your Watchlist to keep track of your new discoveries and view them later. The Watchlist is shared across your devices, so you can even add to your Watchlist from your TV or phone and laptop through Search on any browser.
Take your favorites on-the-go
Your recommendations, Library and Watchlist go with you wherever you go, whether it is out the front door or just to the other room. Start streaming right on your mobile device, or download your previously purchased entertainment from your Library to watch when you're not connected.
Use your phone as your Google TV / Android TV remote
With a remote built right into the app, you can find something great to watch even when the couch has eaten your remote. And you can use your phone’s keyboard to quickly type complicated passwords, movie names or search terms on your Google TV or other Android TV OS device
Learn more about Google TV: https://tv.google

apple-macos:1600032828.name: Utility Radar
apple-macos:1600032828.description:
With Utility Radar, you can view real-time day-ahead electricity prices on the EPEX SPOT market (quarterly & hourly) as well as natural gas prices on the Dutch TTF Natural Gas market (gas prices are available in The Netherlands only).
Supported markets for electricity prices (EPEX):
- Austria
- Belgium
- Denmark
- Germany
- Finland
- France
- The Netherlands
- Norway
- Poland
- Spain
- Sweden
- Switzerland
Supported markets for gas prices:
- The Netherlands (Dutch TTF)
Electricity:
- View today's rates
- View tomorrow's rates (available around 13:00 CET)
- A customisable graph with rates
- Homescreen widgets
- Lockscreen widgets (iOS 16)
Natural Gas (The Netherlands only):
- View the current rate
- View the average rate of the last few months
